tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// skyu ra a skyabs la zhu yig bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs la spyi bos gus par phyag 'tshal lo// yon tan rin chen dpag med 'byung ba'i gnas// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bor gyur pa ste// rdo rje 'chang dang ro gcig gnyis med gyur// rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la spyi bos gus phyag 'tshal// bod kyi yul gangs ri byang ngos kyi rgyud/ mdo khams kyi sgang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chos dar ba'i yul 'bri klung na bzhugs pa/ skye ba mang po nas tshogs bsags pa'i rten/ mi'i lus rin po che brnyes nas/ gdung rus mchog tu gyur pa/ skyu ra mdzog khyim du sku 'khrungs la/ skye ba mang po nas sbyin pa la sogs pa tshogs mang po bsags pa/ bsod nams kyi dpal 'bar ba/ phyogs dang ris med cing*/ ltos pa med par bdog pa thams cad gtong ba/ nang gi ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' zhing*/ lus ngag gi dge sbyor la brtson 'grus kyis go cha chen po bgos pa can/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod kyi gzhung lugs mang po mkhyen zhing*/ gsung ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdzod chen po mnga' ba/ bla ma rnams la gus shing rdo rje 'chang dang gnyis su med par gzigs pa/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi blo dor zhing*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i thugs 'ba' zhig mnga' ba'i bla ma mtshan don dang ldan pa'i phyag tu/ 'bangs kyi grwa pa/ gtsang la stod grom pa sa skya'i ban+de kun dga' snying pos/ phrin yig gi shog bu 'bul ba/ rje bla ma dam pa sngar ni sku khams bde bar khums/ slad kyi sku khams bde'am zhes pa yang nas yang du mang du rmed/ slad kyi don zhu ba/ rtag tu bla ma'i zhabs drung du 'khor zhing*/ ci 'byor gyi bsnyen bkur gyis bla ma mnyes par spro ba lags na/ yul gyis bskal nas grub pa can du ma thal/ 'on kyang bla ma bsnyen bkur ba rgyang ring po nas bgyir rung ba lags na/

'byor pa'i dbang gis gang yang grub par ma thal/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa rgyud sde mtha' yas pa dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub la sogs pas kyang*/ mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni// bla ma mchod pa mchog tu bshad// ces gsungs pas/ bla ma dam pa la sku khams 'dri ba'i yi ge'i rten ther snam na bza' gnyis kyi rgyu/ dbus kyi phrugs chung na bza' gnyis kyi rgyu/ ther snam phra sbom na bza' gnyis kyi rgyu mchis pas/ sku la bsnams pa dang gdan mdzad par zhu/ chab gser srang gcig gi bzang drug pho ba ris dang pi pi ling sa skya'i khri bdun/ sman tsha sa skya'i srang bcu bzhi/ de dag gis thugs la ji ltar dgongs pa'i bya ba mdzad par zhu lags/ slad kyi bla ma la dmigs pa'i gdugs gcig la sogs pa zhabs tog phran tshegs 'ga' mchis na/ da res ma brtsams par thal te bkas mi bkyon par zhu/ phyi lo phyag tu thengs par bgyid/ bsnyen bkur ba'i dngos po 'di dag shin tu chung bar mchis kyang*/ dang ba'i bsam pas bla ma la bsnyen bkur ba lags pas phyag tu bzhes par zhu/ 'di la brten nas/ bdag gi rgyud kyi kun nas nyon mongs pa thams cad dag pa dang*/ dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa thams cad skong bar byin gyis brlab par zhu/ dngos kyi ka cha phran tshegs 'di dang*/ yi ge 'di dang mjal nas bla ma'i thugs dgongs thams cad 'grub cing*/ bkra shis par smon pa dang bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyang bar chad zhi nas tshe rabs thams cad du bla ma rnams kyi bran du skye bar smon// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
